summary: A teacher's last day is marked by students writing advice letters for next year's class, saying what the teacher is like.
realLife: A fifth-grade teacher's farewell tradition has students write letters to next year's students, with playful advice such as listening the first time she speaks.
sources: WLRN, last day of school in Miami, a teacher says goodbye (2019): https://www.wlrn.org/news/2019-06-06/today-is-the-last-day-of-school-in-miami-this-teacher-says-goodbye-after-45-years
inGame: a school record; needs: classroom traditions

turns.summary: The letters aren't written because next year is unsettled.
turns.writesBack: a missing ritual; a journal note

turns.summary: Students write long praise and no advice.
The teacher keeps the batch to read later.
